name: Fish Satchel

pages.text: Use while held to open it; automatic fish collection works while it is open.

pages.title: Collecting catches
pages.text: Craft through JEI. Use the held satchel to open it. While open it automatically collects fish; closing it disables that automatic behavior. Check its state before a fishing trip.
